title: Meeting follow-up
description: Turns a sales call transcript into a summary, action items, a follow-up email and CRM fields.

spec.output: Summary, action items, follow-up email, CRM fields
spec.whereItRuns: Microsoft 365: Teams meeting transcript + Power Automate flow

problem: After each sales call, the account manager rereads notes or the transcript, writes the follow-up email, and updates the CRM by hand. Action items without a clear owner or date slip, and CRM fields like volume, next step and competitors are often left blank.

steps.label: Input
steps.text: The Teams transcript of a sales call is available once the meeting ends.

steps.label: AI step
steps.text: Claude summarizes the call and pulls out action items, owners, dates, volumes and competitors.

steps.label: Check
steps.text: Anything unclear or missing, such as an unknown volume or an action with no date, is flagged for the account manager.

steps.label: Output
steps.text: The follow-up email lands as a draft in Outlook and the CRM fields are proposed for the Dynamics 365 opportunity.

stack.name: Claude
stack.role: Reads the transcript and writes the summary, actions, email and CRM fields.

stack.name: Dynamics 365
stack.role: Receives the CRM fields on the opportunity record.

stack.name: Outlook
stack.role: Holds the follow-up email as a draft for the account manager.

stack.name: Power Automate
stack.role: Runs the flow when a transcript is ready and routes the results.

tryIt.placeholder: Paste a sales call transcript with speaker names.

samples.label: Discovery call with a pilot proposal
